seo.defaultDescription: A production-ready full-stack template with authentication, payments, email, and more.

manifest.name: FullStack Template
manifest.description: A production-ready full-stack template built with Next.js

marketing.heroTitle: Ship faster with a production-ready template
marketing.heroDescription: Authentication, payments, email, database, analytics, and SEO pre-wired so you can focus on what makes your product unique.
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Stop rebuilding the same infrastructure. Start building your product.
marketing.ctaDescription: Create your account and launch your first project in minutes.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Email/password, OAuth, email verification, and role-based access out of the box.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Stripe integration with subscription management and webhook handling.

email.title: Email
email.description: Transactional email with Resend and React Email templates, with SMTP fallback.

database.title: Database
database.description: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, type-safe queries, and migration tooling.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Privacy-respecting analytics with PostHog and cookie consent built in.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: Sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph images, JSON-LD structured data, and metadata factory.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Simple, transparent pricing. No hidden fees.
